# skyhub_firewall_rule (Resource)

An inbound or outbound firewall rule (Security > Firewall Rules). A rule is identified by its direction, IP version and service name; the hub allows one rule per service and direction. Changing `action`, addresses or `logging` deletes and re-adds the rule (it is briefly absent); `enabled` and `position` are applied through the list page without recreating it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skyhub_firewall_rule" "ssh_in" {
  direction    = "in"
  service      = skyhub_service.ssh_alt.name
  action       = "allow_always"
  lan_start_ip = "192.168.50.20"
  wan_type     = "range"
  wan_start_ip = "203.0.113.1"
  wan_end_ip   = "203.0.113.9"
  logging      = "always"
}

resource "skyhub_firewall_rule" "block_telnet_out" {
  direction = "out"
  service   = "TELNET"
  action    = "block_always"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) `allow_always`, `allow_schedule`, `block_always` or `block_schedule`.
- `direction` (String) `in` (WAN to LAN) or `out` (LAN to WAN).
- `service` (String) Built-in service name (e.g. `SSH`, `HTTP`, `Any(All)`) or a `skyhub_service` name.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the rule is active (default true).
- `ip_version` (Number) 4 or 6 (default 4).
- `lan_end_ip` (String) End of the LAN range (outbound `range`).
- `lan_ipv6` (String) IPv6 rules: `<prefix>|<interface id>` (e.g. `2001:db8:1:2|::10`) or just an interface id to use the hub's global prefix.
- `lan_start_ip` (String) LAN IPv4 host (inbound: required; outbound: for `single`/`range`).
- `lan_type` (String) Outbound IPv4 only: `any`, `single` or `range` (default `any`). Inbound IPv4 rules always target the single host in `lan_start_ip`.
- `logging` (String) `never`, `always`, `match` or `not_match` (default `never`).
- `position` (Number) 1-based position in the list. Unset: appended at the end and tracked.
- `wan_end_ip` (String) End of the WAN range.
- `wan_end_ipv6` (String) IPv6 rules: end of the WAN range.
- `wan_start_ip` (String) WAN IPv4 address (for `single`/`range`).
- `wan_start_ipv6` (String) IPv6 rules: WAN address for `single`/`range`.
- `wan_type` (String) `any`, `single` or `range` (default `any`).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<direction>/<ip_version>/<service>`, e.g. `in/4/SSH`.
- `lan_users` (String) LAN column as displayed by the hub (informational).
- `wan_servers` (String) WAN column as displayed by the hub (informational).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import skyhub_firewall_rule.ssh_in in/4/SvcC
```
